text: In Lab 13 the 3-layer DeepESN (3×100 neurons) and the single-ESN baseline (N=300) contain the same total number of reservoir neurons.
explanation: True. The lab deliberately matches capacity: LAYER_SIZES = [100,100,100] gives 300 neurons total, equal to N_SINGLE = 300. This isolates the benefit of DEPTH (a timescale hierarchy) from the trivial benefit of simply adding neurons.
